subject: 2 lines within only _one_ plot of facet_wrap

messages.author: e7e95b47f1608404
messages.subject: 2 lines within only _one_ plot of facet_wrap
parts:
Dear all,

Having my.data.frame with 3 columns: date, variable (5 levels) and value I can do

ggplot(my.data.frame, aes(x = date, y = value) ) + geom_line() + facet_wrap(~variable, scale = "free_y")

and obtain 5 nicely arranged individual plots, one for each level of 'variable'.  I would like to have 4 plots, the first combining 2 of the levels.  Can this be done? Any idea would be appreciated.

--
Kindly,
Bob Pap

messages.author: 373beb702917b8b5
messages.subject: Re: 2 lines within only _one_ plot of facet_wrap
parts:
Sure, just combine levels one and 2 of 'variable' before plotting.If
'variable' is a factor you can use

levels(my.data.frame$variable)[1:2] <- "one or two"

Best,
Ista

example (if you need help with this, refer to the link at the bottom
of every post on the ggplot2 forum). Also please keep the list copied.

messages.author: e7e95b47f1608404
messages.subject: Re: 2 lines within only _one_ plot of facet_wrap
parts:
Many thanks,dear Ista, the code below worked (will figure out labelling)

new.data.frame <- within(
data.frame, {
group <- ifelse(variable %in% c("one","two"),as.character(variable),NA)
facet <- ifelse(variable %in% c("one","two"), "one or two", as.character(variable))
}
)
ggplot(new.data.frame, aes(x = date, y = value, group=group) ) + geom_line() + facet_wrap(~facet, scale = "free_y")

PS. Sorry about the reply, I thought it was "reply to all", need to get used to chrome. 

Kindly,
Bob Pap
